entries.name: @input/pen-ai
entries.note: v3 Wave 6 SF1 re-record 2026-08-24. The five AI satellites became subpaths of this package, so the budget is now the whole shipped ESM closure rather than dist/index.mjs: tsup code-splits the subpaths into content-hashed chunks, and a hashed name cannot be written into a baseline. Replaces six budgets totalling 604703 B (435771 root + 75536 autocomplete + 47823 suggestions + 25211 delta-stream + 15831 tools + 4531 skills). 604703 → 607722, +0.5% for duplicated barrel wiring; no satellite budget was dropped without a successor. Byte total reproduced across three rebuilds.

_deferred.note: Empty, and discharged rather than abandoned. Three packages (bench, core, dom) were deferred earlier the same day because their sources were being edited while the baseline was taken; each was re-recorded once its lane reported and a rebuild produced the same byte count twice. Keep this mechanism: deferring a mid-edit package leaves it failing against the last quiet baseline, which is the honest state, whereas recording a half-finished package silently blesses whatever size it happened to have. Re-record only after a rebuild reproduces the number.
